name: graphlay
description: Deterministic layered graph layout, tidy trees and SVG rendering. Rust compiled to WebAssembly, for the browser and Node.

scripts.build: pnpm build:wasm && pnpm build:types && pnpm build:ts
scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build .. --target web --out-dir js/src/pkg --out-name graphlay --release -- --config profile.release.opt-level=3 --config profile.release.lto=true --config profile.release.codegen-units=1 --config 'profile.release.panic="abort"' --config profile.release.strip=true && wasm-opt -O3 --enable-bulk-memory --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int -o src/pkg/graphlay_bg.wasm src/pkg/graphlay_bg.wasm && node scripts/inline-wasm.mjs
